title: Service Request #2: Why Is This Red Light So Damn Long?

sentences.en: So we are driving around Los Angeles at the best time of day, 5.41 p.m.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在一天中最好的时刻——下午5点41分，在洛杉矶开车兜风。

sentences.en: Vivian Leg works with me at 99% Invisible,
sentences.zh: 维维安·莱格和我一起在《99%隐形》工作，

sentences.en: and she's on her way out for after-work drinks at one of her favorite bars in L.A.
sentences.zh: 她正赶去洛杉矶她最喜欢的一家酒吧喝下班后的饮品。

sentences.en: And my husband Cody is driving us, I'd like to say, because I'm recording.
sentences.zh: 我的丈夫科迪在开车，我想说是因为我在录音。

sentences.en: But you're driving me because what?
sentences.zh: 但你开车载我是因为什么？

sentences.en: Because you're a passenger princess.
sentences.zh: 因为你是个副驾公主。

sentences.en: That's exactly correct.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Some people enjoy driving.
sentences.zh: 有些人喜欢开车。

sentences.en: Some people, like Vivian, really do not.
sentences.zh: 而有些人，比如维维安，真的很讨厌。

sentences.en: But nobody enjoys being stuck in traffic.
sentences.zh: 但没有人喜欢被堵在路上。

sentences.en: No one's moving.
sentences.zh: 根本一动不动。

sentences.en: What are they doing?
sentences.zh: 他们在干什么？

sentences.en: I want to burn the intersection to the ground and piss on the ashes.
sentences.zh: 我想把这个路口烧成平地，然后在灰烬上撒尿。

sentences.en: Oh my god.
sentences.zh: 我的天哪。

sentences.en: L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶

sentences.en: is famously a car town,
sentences.zh: 是出了名的汽车之城，

sentences.en: known for its endless freeways and its soul-crushing rush hour traffic.
sentences.zh: 以其无尽的高速公路和令人崩溃的晚高峰交通而闻名。

sentences.en: And in a city full of bad intersections,
sentences.zh: 在这座充满糟糕路口的城市里，

sentences.en: Vivian and Cody are headed towards one that many consider to be the worSt.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安和科迪正朝着许多人认为最糟糕的一个路口驶去。

sentences.en: It's where three roads, Fairfax, Olympic, and San Vicente, all intersect.
sentences.zh: 那是费尔法克斯大道、奥林匹克大道和圣维森特大道三条道路交汇的地方。

sentences.en: I think it's technically called the Fairfax asterisk,
sentences.zh: 我想它在技术上被称为费尔法克斯星号路口，

sentences.en: but I like to think of it as the devil's three-way because you have this weird triangle in the middle
sentences.zh: 但我更愿意称之为魔鬼三角恋，因为中间有一个奇怪的三角形，

sentences.en: and there are like one, two, three, four, five traffic lights.
sentences.zh: 而且大概有一、二、三、四、五个红绿灯。

sentences.en: To navigate this intersection, Vivian and Cody have to make it through two traffic lights
sentences.zh: 为了通过这个路口，薇薇安和科迪必须穿过两个红绿灯，

sentences.en: in quick succession, only a couple hundred feet apart.
sentences.zh: 这两个红绿灯相距极近，仅有几百英尺远。

sentences.en: Oh god.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: You get caught right in the middle of...
sentences.zh: 你正好被困在……

sentences.en: Oh no.
sentences.zh: 噢不。

sentences.en: We are stuck in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我们被困在中间了。

sentences.en: They make it through one traffic light, but then get stopped at the next one.
sentences.zh: 他们闯过了一个红绿灯，但在下一个红绿灯前被拦了下来。

sentences.en: And now they're stuck right in the middle of the triangle.
sentences.zh: 现在他们被困在这个三角形的正中央。

sentences.en: Oh god.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So there are...
sentences.zh: 所以这里有……

sentences.en: Oh god.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: We're...
sentences.zh: 我们……

sentences.en: Oh boy.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: We are in between...
sentences.zh: 我们夹在……

sentences.en: Oh my god.
sentences.zh: 我的天呐。

sentences.en: I'm Delaney Hall and this is Service Request
sentences.zh: 我是德兰尼·霍尔，这里是《服务请求》

sentences.en: from 99% Invisible and Campside Media.
sentences.zh: 由 99% Invisible 和 Campside Media 联合制作。

sentences.en: We rarely think about infrastructure until it breaks.
sentences.zh: 我们很少去想基础设施，直到它坏掉。

sentences.en: And then suddenly, it is all we can think about.
sentences.zh: 然后突然之间，我们满脑子想的都是它。

sentences.en: So every week, we're diving into your burning questions about the invisible systems all around us.
sentences.zh: 所以每周，我们都会深入探讨你对身边那些看不见系统的迫切疑问。

sentences.en: We're exploring how infrastructure works and how it's designed and maintained.
sentences.zh: 我们将探索基础设施是如何运作的，以及它是如何设计和维护的。

sentences.en: Today, traffic lights in LA.
sentences.zh: 今天，洛杉矶的红绿灯。

sentences.en: We're looking at the system behind them,
sentences.zh: 我们将了解它们背后的系统，

sentences.en: meeting the people who decide when they flip from one color to another,
sentences.zh: 认识那些决定红绿灯何时变色的人，

sentences.en: and trying to answer the question on every LA driver's mind.
sentences.zh: 并试图回答每个洛杉矶司机心中的疑问。

sentences.en: Why is this red light so damn long?
sentences.zh: 为什么这个红灯这么要命的长？

sentences.en: Oh, you son of a bitch.
sentences.zh: 哦，你这王八蛋。

sentences.en: The roots of LA's modern traffic system go back to 1984,
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶现代交通系统的根源可以追溯到1984年，

sentences.en: when the city was preparing to host the Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 当时这座城市正准备举办奥运会。

sentences.en: LA was expecting more than a million visitors and thousands of athletes.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶预计将迎来一百多万游客和数千名运动员。

sentences.en: Traffic in LA was bad.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶的交通很糟糕。

sentences.en: And all these people would be flooding into a city that was already pretty maxed out.
sentences.zh: 所有这些人将涌入一个本就已经不堪重负的城市。

sentences.en: City leaders were worried that athletes and spectators wouldn't be able to make it to their events.
sentences.zh: 城市领导者担心运动员和观众无法按时赶到比赛现场。

sentences.en: You're going to the 1984 Olympics in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 你要去洛杉矶参加1984年奥运会。

sentences.en: And some of your friends are asking you questions.
sentences.zh: 有些朋友会问你一些问题。

sentences.en: Aren't those freeways congested?
sentences.zh: 那些高速公路不是很拥堵吗？

sentences.en: Can you find your way around?
sentences.zh: 你能找到路吗？

sentences.en: What about the smog?
sentences.zh: 烟雾问题怎么办？

sentences.en: At this time, all of the traffic lights in LA operated independently from each other.
sentences.zh: 在当时，洛杉矶所有的红绿灯都是各自独立运作的。

sentences.en: Each one had a timing mechanism that would flip the light from green to yellow to red on a regular cadence.
sentences.zh: 每一个都有一个定时机制，会按照固定的节奏把灯从绿灯变成黄灯再变成红灯。

sentences.en: If a traffic light broke, or if an intersection got extra congested,
sentences.zh: 如果红绿灯坏了，或者某个路口变得格外拥堵，

sentences.en: engineers would likely find out about it from angry phone calls.
sentences.zh: 工程师们通常是通过愤怒的投诉电话才得知情况。

sentences.en: And then someone from the city would have to drive out to that intersection
sentences.zh: 然后城市里会派人开车去那个路口，

sentences.en: to manually reprogram the timing mechanism of the traffic light.
sentences.zh: 手动重新编程红绿灯的定时机制。

sentences.en: In the process, they would often get stuck in the same congestion they were trying to fix.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，他们往往会陷入他们正试图解决的同一场交通拥堵中。

sentences.en: But the Olympics gave city engineers the motivation and the funding to try something new.
sentences.zh: 但奥运会给了城市工程师尝试新事物的动力和资金。

sentences.en: With the games looming, a transportation official named Ed Rowey
sentences.zh: 随着奥运会的临近，一位名叫埃德·罗维的交通官员

sentences.en: assembled a small team, and they started tinkering.
sentences.zh: 组建了一个小团队，他们开始进行摸索。

sentences.en: And what they came up with was a network that connected 118 traffic lights
sentences.zh: 他们想出的方案是一个连接了118个红绿灯的网络，

sentences.en: around the LA Coliseum into a single system.
sentences.zh: 这些红绿灯环绕着洛杉矶纪念体育场，组成了一个单一的系统。

sentences.en: For the first time, instead of sending someone out to every congested intersection,
sentences.zh: 这是第一次，工程师们不再需要派人去每个拥堵的路口，

sentences.en: engineers could see what was happening across a whole area
sentences.zh: 而是能够看到整个区域正在发生的事情

sentences.en: and then adjust signal timing remotely, in real time.
sentences.zh: 然后实时远程调整信号灯配时。

sentences.en: The system went online just before the game started.
sentences.zh: 该系统在比赛开始前夕正式上线。

sentences.en: It was an experiment, and it worked.
sentences.zh: 这是一次实验，而且成功了。

sentences.en: This is Salita Reynolds.
sentences.zh: 这位是萨利塔·雷诺兹。

sentences.en: She's the chief innovation officer at LA Metro.
sentences.zh: 她是洛杉矶大都会交通局的首席创新官。

sentences.en: And for eight years, she ran LA's traffic light system,
sentences.zh: 在过去的八年里，她负责管理洛杉矶的红绿灯系统，

sentences.en: trying to make traffic a little bit better in one of the most traffic-y cities in the world.
sentences.zh: 试图在世界上交通状况最糟糕的城市之一，让交通变得稍微好一点。

sentences.en: There are a lot of other really interesting things that happened during the 84 Games to make it
sentences.zh: 在84年奥运会期间，还发生了很多其他非常有趣的事情，才使得奥运会

sentences.en: such a success.
sentences.zh: 取得如此巨大的成功。

sentences.en: But if you ask anybody who was here at the time,
sentences.zh: 但如果你问任何当时在场的人，

sentences.en: they will say, wow, they really solved traffic.
sentences.zh: 他们都会说，哇，他们真的解决了交通问题。

sentences.en: The first full day of Olympic competition saw a few hurdles on the massive LA freeway system.
sentences.zh: 奥运会正式比赛的第一天，庞大的洛杉矶高速公路网就遇到了一些障碍。

sentences.en: The Games not only avoided gridlock, but the sea breezes also cooperated.
sentences.zh: 奥运会不仅避免了交通瘫痪，海风也非常配合。

sentences.en: And sort of famously, when the Games were over, the mayor at the time, Tom Bradley,
sentences.zh: 而且众所周知，奥运会结束时，时任市长汤姆·布拉德利

sentences.en: at the closing sort of press conference said,
sentences.zh: 在闭幕新闻发布会上说，

sentences.en: the Games are over, let the traffic begin.
sentences.zh: 奥运会结束了，让交通开始吧。

sentences.en: So, you know, there was this sort of feeling that everybody had kind of made it work
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当时大家都有这样一种感觉，就是每个人都在奥运会期间

sentences.en: for the period of the Games, and now we were going to be back to our old ways.
sentences.zh: 让一切顺利运转，而现在我们要回到老路子上了。

sentences.en: It reminds me a little of the extraordinary measures you hear every city taking,
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一些你听说每个城市都会采取的非凡措施，

sentences.en: like Beijing firing particulate into the air to make the smog, like, rain away
sentences.zh: 比如北京在奥运会人群到来之前向空中发射颗粒物，让雾霾

sentences.en: before the crowds came for the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 像下雨一样消散。

sentences.en: So it's interesting to me that in many ways it was one of these extraordinary measures
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得有趣的是，在许多方面，这是一项非凡的措施

sentences.en: that was taken to try to solve a problem temporarily for the Olympics,
sentences.zh: 旨在试图为奥运会临时解决一个问题，

sentences.en: but then it continued.
sentences.zh: 但后来它延续了下来。

sentences.en: Why did it continue?
sentences.zh: 为什么它会延续下来？

sentences.en: I think the engineers at the time were very excited by the improvements that they had seen,
sentences.zh: 我认为当时的工程师对他们所看到的改善感到非常兴奋，

sentences.en: and they were real and measurable.
sentences.zh: 而且这些改善是真实的、可测量的。

sentences.en: They had reduced people's delay by about 30, 35 percent,
sentences.zh: 他们将人们的延误减少了大约30%、35%，

sentences.en: which in turn improved emissions, right, because you didn't have as many people idling,
sentences.zh: 这反过来又减少了尾气排放，对吧，因为怠速的人没那么多了，

sentences.en: because you were just moving the most efficient way possible.
sentences.zh: 因为你正以尽可能最高效的方式通行。

sentences.en: LA's success with traffic during the Olympics made a big impact.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶奥运会期间在交通治理上取得的成功产生了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Cities planning future Olympics called them for advice.
sentences.zh: 筹办未来奥运会的城市纷纷向他们征求建议。

sentences.en: And in the years that followed, officials from Salt Lake City and Sydney and Beijing
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，来自盐湖城、悉尼和北京的官员

sentences.en: all wanted to study what LA's transit leaders had built.
sentences.zh: 都想要研究洛杉矶交通领袖们所建设的系统。

sentences.en: As the system continued to expand, it got even more sophisticated,
sentences.zh: 随着该系统不断扩展，它变得更加先进，

sentences.en: with new high-tech tools that could sense the conditions on the roads
sentences.zh: 配备了能够感知道路状况的高科技新工具，

sentences.en: and then respond automatically.
sentences.zh: 并能够自动做出响应。

sentences.en: Los Angeles is now trying to unsnarl its traffic by applying some very advanced technology.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶目前正试图通过应用一些非常先进的技术来疏导交通。

sentences.en: The city has begun to plant electronic sensors beneath major downtown intersections.
sentences.zh: 这座城市已经开始在市中心主要路口下方埋设电子传感器。

sentences.en: Those sensors determine the speed and density of traffic
sentences.zh: 这些传感器能够测定交通的车速和密度，

sentences.en: and feed that information to a computer beneath City Hall.
sentences.zh: 并将这些信息实时传输给市政厅底下的计算机。

sentences.en: The computer analyzes the information and automatically operates traffic lights
sentences.zh: 计算机对这些信息进行分析，并自动操控交通信号灯，

sentences.en: to relieve congestion and speed up traffic flow.
sentences.zh: 以缓解交通拥堵并加快车流速度。

sentences.en: We reduced delay at intersections by about 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 我们将路口延误时间减少了大约百分之二十。

sentences.en: We reduced stops by 35 percent.
sentences.zh: 我们将停车次数减少了百分之三十五。

sentences.en: By the way, that last voice was Ed Rowe, who died in 2023.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，刚才那个声音的主人是埃德·罗，他于2023年去世。

sentences.en: When we come back, we'll learn about how LA's traffic system has grown since the Olympics
sentences.zh: 广告回来后，我们将了解洛杉矶的交通系统自奥运会以来是如何发展的，

sentences.en: and why it is now known as the eighth wonder of the transportation world.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么它现在被称为交通世界的第八大奇迹。

sentences.en: That's after the break.
sentences.zh: 广告之后马上回来。

sentences.en: Since 1984, the small, scrappy system that started with the Olympics
sentences.zh: 自1984年以来，这个从奥运会开始起步、规模虽小却充满韧性的系统，

sentences.en: has grown into one of the most sophisticated traffic management operations in the world.
sentences.zh: 已经发展成为世界上最先进的交通管理运营系统之一。

sentences.en: Today, it's known as ATSAC, Advanced Transportation System and Coordination,
sentences.zh: 如今，它被称为ATSAC，即先进交通系统与协调中心，

sentences.en: and it controls almost all of the city's 5,000 traffic signals.
sentences.zh: 它控制着全市近5000个交通信号灯中的几乎全部。

sentences.en: And while it would be malpractice to say that the system has solved LA's traffic issues,
sentences.zh: 尽管说这个系统已经彻底解决了洛杉矶的交通问题未免有些言过其实，

sentences.en: it has made traffic a little less bad.
sentences.zh: 但它确实让交通情况稍微没那么糟糕了。

sentences.en: Believe it or not, without this system, the streets of LA would be even more clogged.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，如果没有这个系统，洛杉矶的街道将会堵塞得更加严重。

sentences.en: The way it works is that there are sensors buried in the pavement at most intersections across the city,
sentences.zh: 其工作原理是，城市中大多数交叉路口的路面下都埋有传感器，

sentences.en: and they count cars as they pass.
sentences.zh: 它们会统计驶过的车辆。

sentences.en: The sensors feed a constant stream of data back to a control room in downtown LA,
sentences.zh: 传感器将源源不断的数据流输送回洛杉矶市中心的控制室，

sentences.en: where engineers can watch a live map of LA traffic.
sentences.zh: 工程师可以在那里查看洛杉矶交通的实时地图。

sentences.en: When a street starts to back up, the system automatically responds.
sentences.zh: 当某条街道开始出现拥堵时，系统会自动做出响应。

sentences.en: It can extend a green light, or make one shorter,
sentences.zh: 它可以延长绿灯时间，或者缩短绿灯时间，

sentences.en: nudging timing across the whole system of intersections to help traffic flow more smoothly.
sentences.zh: 微调整个交叉路口系统的配时，以帮助交通更顺畅地通行。

sentences.en: And there are traffic engineers, transportation engineers, and planners, and other folks
sentences.zh: 还有交通工程师、运输工程师、规划人员以及其他一些工作人员，

sentences.en: that are sitting in an office in downtown Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在洛杉矶市中心的一间办公室里。

sentences.en: They have hundreds of cameras that give them basically a 360-degree view of the city at any time.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有数百个摄像头，基本上可以随时提供这座城市的360度全景视野。

sentences.en: And they also have a landscape view of what's happening with every single transportation signal
sentences.zh: 他们还能全局掌控每一个交通信号灯的情况，

sentences.en: at all of the 5,000-plus intersections that they're monitoring at any given time.
sentences.zh: 在任何给定时间，他们监控的交叉路口多达5000多个。

sentences.en: So these various signals run into ATSAC,
sentences.zh: 因此，这些各种信号汇入ATSAC，

sentences.en: which I am imagining as sort of the NASA Mission Control Center.
sentences.zh: 我在想象中，它有点像美国宇航局的任务控制中心。

sentences.en: Is that what it looks like?
sentences.zh: 是那个样子的吗？

sentences.en: Kind of, yes.
sentences.zh: 差不多，是的。

sentences.en: Houston, we have our truck.
sentences.zh: 休斯顿，我们找到卡车了。

sentences.en: It is number 128.
Selena told me the ATSAC control room has become legendary among traffic nerds,
sentences.zh: 赛琳娜告诉我，ATSAC控制室在交通迷中间已经成了一个传奇，

sentences.en: and it's been featured in a couple of movies,
sentences.zh: 而且它还出现在好几部电影里，

sentences.en: including a 2003 heist film called The Italian Job.
sentences.zh: 包括2003年的一部劫盗片《偷天换日》。

sentences.en: We're moving out.
sentences.zh: 我们要出去了。

sentences.en: There's this scene where someone hacks into the ATSAC system to create a huge traffic jam in the middle of L.A.
sentences.zh: 其中有个场景是有人黑进ATSAC系统，在洛杉矶市中心造成了巨大的交通大堵塞。

sentences.en: Gridlock time.
sentences.zh: 大塞车时间到。

sentences.en: We've crashed.
sentences.zh: 我们崩溃了。

sentences.en: It's not a crash.
sentences.zh: 这不是崩溃。

sentences.en: We've got power.
sentences.zh: 我们有电。

sentences.en: I can't log in.
sentences.zh: 我登不进去。

sentences.en: And there's a shot of the ATSAC control room in the movie with engineers holding their heads in their hands,
sentences.zh: 电影里有一个镜头是ATSAC控制室，工程师们双手抱头，

sentences.en: staring at these enormous screens that show intersections across the city.
sentences.zh: 盯着那些巨大的屏幕，上面显示着全市各处的交叉路口。

sentences.en: They're totally freaking out as cars smash into each other and traffic descends into chaos.
sentences.zh: 当汽车相撞、交通陷入混乱时，他们彻底抓狂了。

sentences.en: So in that control room, you're saying it's a mix of technology and human intervention to make the signals change.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个控制室里，你是说这是科技和人工干预的结合，来改变信号灯吗？

sentences.en: So in some cases, there's a person pressing buttons, flipping switches, and making the lights change.
sentences.zh: 所以在某些情况下，会有人按按钮、扳开关，让红绿灯发生变化。

sentences.en: They can do that in extraordinary circumstances.
sentences.zh: 他们在非常时期可以这样做。

sentences.en: So when I first got to Los Angeles, there was actually a giant sinkhole that opened up in the ground over by UCLA.
sentences.zh: 所以当我刚到洛杉矶时，加州大学洛杉矶分校（UCLA）附近实际上地面上裂开了一个巨大的天坑。

sentences.en: Less dramatic than that.
sentences.zh: 没有那么戏剧化。

sentences.en: There's spontaneous protests or other things happening.
sentences.zh: 会有自发的抗议活动或其他事情发生。

sentences.en: At that point, they're making decisions about, okay,
sentences.zh: 在那时，他们正在做决定，好吧，

sentences.en: we're going to leave this light on green for longer and clear people out of a space when they need to be redirected or rerouted.
sentences.zh: 我们要让这个绿灯亮更长时间，当需要重定向或改道时，把人们从一个空间疏散出去。

sentences.en: But these are mostly extraordinary circumstances.
sentences.zh: 但这些大多是特殊情况。

sentences.en: For the most part, it sounds like there are computers that are making decisions about when to flip from green to yellow.
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，听起来好像是由计算机来决定什么时候从绿灯切换到黄灯。

sentences.en: Yeah, think about the way that we're managing movement through a city.
sentences.zh: 对，想想我们在城市中管理流动的方式。

sentences.en: You know, we're managing it in space and time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在空间和时间上进行管理。

sentences.en: And the space is limited, right?
sentences.zh: 空间是有限的，对吧？

sentences.en: We have 7,500 miles of streets in the city of Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶市有7500英里的街道。

sentences.en: So there's a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多。

sentences.en: But we have what we have.
sentences.zh: 但我们有什么就用什么。

sentences.en: It's fixed.
sentences.zh: 它是固定的。

sentences.en: So that congestion that you experience, that's too much demand for a fixed amount of space.
sentences.zh: 所以你经历的拥堵，那是固定空间里过多的需求。

sentences.en: I like this idea that traffic engineering is all about space and time.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这种观点，交通工程全关于空间和时间。

sentences.en: Because it elevates what seems like a mundane discipline into something a little more epic.
sentences.zh: 因为它把一门看似平凡的学科提升到了一点史诗般的境界。

sentences.en: The space part is pretty simple.
sentences.zh: 空间部分很简单。

sentences.en: Basically, every car, bus, bicycle, and pedestrian is competing for the same fixed space on the roads.
sentences.zh: 基本上，每辆汽车、公共汽车、自行车和行人在道路上争夺着相同的固定空间。

sentences.en: And the reality is that engineers cannot do much to expand that space.
sentences.zh: 现实是，工程师们在扩大空间方面做不了太多。

sentences.en: But they can work with time.
sentences.zh: 但他们可以利用时间。

sentences.en: And that's where their special algorithms come in.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的特殊算法发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: There is so much data collected from those sensors embedded in the pavement.
sentences.zh: 从嵌入路面的传感器收集了大量的数据。

sentences.en: And it reveals stuff like rush hour patterns and holiday surges and what a Wednesday on the road looks like versus a Sunday.
sentences.zh: 它揭示了诸如上下班高峰期模式、假日激增，以及路上的周三与周日有什么不同之类的信息。

sentences.en: And the algorithms crunch through all that information and then translate it into precisely timed traffic lights.
sentences.zh: 算法对所有这些信息进行处理，然后将其转化为精准计时的交通灯。

sentences.en: For the most part, those algorithmic sort of calculations for how much green time one street gets versus the other and that balancing,
sentences.zh: 在大多数情况下，那些关于一条街获得多少绿灯时间与另一条街相比以及这种平衡的算法计算，

sentences.en: it's pretty fixed by the time of day and the day of the week and so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 根据一天中的时间和星期几等等，基本上是固定的。

sentences.en: But there are moments when unpredictable things happen and the sensors have a certain amount of intelligence and they're able to perceive those changes and reallocate things in real time.
sentences.zh: 但有时会发生不可预测的事情，传感器具有一定程度的智能，能够感知这些变化并在实时中重新分配资源。

sentences.en: And then sometimes the system becomes so strained that it breaks and you have to have a human in the loop to intervene and actually manage it manually.
sentences.zh: 有时系统压力太大而崩溃，你必须让控制环路中有人工介入并实际进行手动管理。

sentences.en: And that human needs to be connected to all of the other humans that are there to make things work.
sentences.zh: 而且这个人需要与那里所有其他人保持联系，才能让事情顺利运转。

sentences.en: But to move this many cars and this large of a system that has this much complexity and variation, you have to have all of those things at the same time.
sentences.zh: 但要调动这么多汽车以及这样一个具有如此复杂性和变异性的庞大系统，你必须同时具备所有这些要素。

sentences.en: That sounds like this increasingly sort of brain breaking math problem,
sentences.zh: 这听起来像是一个日益让人头疼的数学问题，

sentences.en: like how you synchronize across that many signals and how you make this intersection flow smoothly without creating chaos in an intersection somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 比如如何在这么多的信号灯之间进行同步，以及如何让这个交叉路口流畅通行，而不会在其他地方的交叉路口造成混乱。

sentences.en: That sounds so hard.
sentences.zh: 这听起来太难了。

sentences.en: It is, and it's also, we're talking about people's lives, right?
sentences.zh: 确实如此，而且这也是关于人们的生活，对吧？

sentences.en: That's one of the reasons why people love transportation is because it has such an immediate effect on people's lives.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么人们热爱交通运输的原因之一，因为它对人们的生活有如此直接的影响。

sentences.en: And so part of what you're also doing is trying to figure out the tolerance that exists across the system for delay or frustration.
sentences.zh: 因此，你所做的事情的一部分也是试图找出整个系统对延迟或挫败感的容忍度。

sentences.en: And so you're having to sort of consider how pain is being spread around and you're having to sort of accept that in order to balance things,
sentences.zh: 因此，你必须考虑痛苦是如何被分摊的，你必须接受为了平衡各方，

sentences.en: everybody has to share the pain a little bit.
sentences.zh: 每个人都必须分担一点痛苦。

sentences.en: And you're also making a judgment call.
sentences.zh: 而且你也在做一个判断。

sentences.en: So on the main drag, there may be, let's say, 45,000 or 50,000 people a day that are driving on that main street.
sentences.zh: 所以在主干道上，比方说，每天可能有45,000或50,000人在这条主街上开车。

sentences.en: On the cross streets, you have a much smaller number of people.
sentences.zh: 在横街上，人数要少得多。

sentences.en: And so you're going to privilege the greatest good for the greatest number, right?
sentences.zh: 所以你要优先考虑最大多数人的最大利益，对吧？

sentences.en: You're going to privilege the 50,000 people on the main line and the people on the side streets are going to experience more pain because they're going to have to wait a little bit longer,
sentences.zh: 你要优先考虑主干道上的50,000人，而小街道上的人会经历更多的痛苦，因为他们必须多等一会儿，

sentences.en: but eventually you're going to get to go.
sentences.zh: 但最终你们还是可以通行。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对的。

sentences.en: What I hear you saying is that it's collective and there's also something a bit utilitarian about it.
sentences.zh: 我听到的意思是它是集体的，同时也有点功利主义的色彩。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And that goes for everybody who's using the street, right?
sentences.zh: 对于每一个使用街道的人来说都是如此，对吧？

sentences.en: People biking and walking as well.
sentences.zh: 骑自行车和步行的人也是。

sentences.en: If there's a bus, right, that's coming along or a train that needs to make it across the street,
sentences.zh: 如果有公交车，对吧，开过来，或者有火车需要穿过街道，

sentences.en: there's a lot more people moving much more efficiently in the train or on the bus or even on a bike taking up a lot less space, which again is one of our most precious resources.
sentences.zh: 在火车上、公交车上甚至骑自行车的人里面有更多的人以更高的效率移动，占用的空间少得多，这又是我们最宝贵的资源之一。

sentences.en: And so figuring out how to balance safety, efficiency, delay,
sentences.zh: 因此，弄清楚如何平衡安全性、效率、延迟，

sentences.en: and the sort of quality of people's lives are all the ingredients that have to go into the creativity with which the system gets managed.
sentences.zh: 以及人们的生活质量，都是管理系统时必须融入的创造力的各种要素。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's interesting to think about this as it's this highly engineered system.
sentences.zh: 对，把这看作是一个高度工程化的系统很有意思。

sentences.en: There's algorithms, there's lights, there's wires, but ultimately it is about people's time.
sentences.zh: 这里有算法、有灯光、有电线，但归根结底，它关乎人们的时间。

sentences.en: It's actually very human.
sentences.zh: 这其实非常有人情味。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I consider it as much of an art as it is a science.
sentences.zh: 我认为它既是一门科学，也是一门艺术。

sentences.en: You know, when we move a little white line on the street, you know, six inches this way or six inches that way, we know that it changes how fast people drive or how they behave.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们把街上的一条小白线，你知道，往这边移六英寸或者往那边移六英寸时，我们知道这会改变人们开车开多快或者他们如何表现。

sentences.en: And so it's a lot more about human behavior than it is about a math equation.
sentences.zh: 所以这更多关乎人类行为，而不是一个数学方程式。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: When we come back, 99PI producer Vivian Lay visits the ATSAC control room.
sentences.zh: 等我们回来后，99PI制作人维维安·莱（Vivian Lay）将访问ATSAC控制室。

sentences.en: Once she's there, she hacks into the system and screws up traffic across L.A.
sentences.zh: 到了那里，她将黑入系统并搞乱洛杉矶各地的交通，

sentences.en: in order to facilitate the movement of a huge amount of stolen gold.
sentences.zh: 以便运送大量被盗的黄金。

sentences.en: Just kidding.
sentences.zh: 开玩笑的。

sentences.en: She just wants to figure out what's up with her least favorite intersection, the Fairfax asterisk.
sentences.zh: 她只是想弄清楚她最讨厌的交叉路口——费尔法克斯星号路口是怎么回事。

sentences.en: That's when we return.
sentences.zh: 我们一会儿回来。

sentences.en: Hi, good morning.
sentences.zh: 嗨，早安。

sentences.en: The ATSAC control room is located in downtown L.A.
sentences.zh: ATSAC控制室位于洛杉矶市中心，

sentences.en: in a huge glass building around the corner from City Hall.
sentences.zh: 在市政厅拐角处的一栋巨大玻璃建筑里。

sentences.en: It's a big space that looks kind of like a corporate meeting room with blue-gray carpet and a wall of glass windows where you can see traffic down below.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很大的空间，看起来有点像公司会议室，铺着蓝灰色地毯，有一面玻璃墙，可以看到下方的交通。

sentences.en: But the main attraction is the huge block of screens that stretches across the front of the room.
sentences.zh: 但最吸引人的是贯穿房间前部的巨大屏幕矩阵。

sentences.en: It displays live camera feeds of intersections across the city so that engineers can keep an eye on where congestion is building up and why it's building up.
sentences.zh: 它显示全市各交叉路口的实时摄像头画面，以便工程师能够密切关注拥堵在哪里加剧以及加剧的原因。

sentences.en: The cameras show me why it's congested.
sentences.zh: 摄像头向我展示了拥堵的原因。

sentences.en: This is Eric Zambon, a transportation engineer in charge of the ATSAC Center.
sentences.zh: 这是埃里克·赞邦（Eric Zambon），负责ATSAC中心的交通工程师。

sentences.en: He gave Vivian a tour last month and talked her through the big screen and what it allows the engineers to see.
sentences.zh: 他上个月带维维安参观了这里，并向她详细介绍了大屏幕以及它让工程师们看到的内容。

sentences.en: Is there an emergency vehicle that's blocking a lane causing congestion or is there even a crash in the middle of the intersection?
sentences.zh: 是否有紧急车辆挡住车道导致拥堵，或者甚至交叉路口中间发生了车祸？

sentences.en: And at that point, we jump on our system and we would modify signal timing parameters to best help people get around those locations.
sentences.zh: 在那时，我们会立即启动系统，修改信号灯定时参数，以最好地帮助人们绕过这些地点。

sentences.en: On that same big screen, there's also a map of every traffic signal in L.A.
sentences.zh: 在同一个大屏幕上，还有一张洛杉矶每个交通信号灯的地图。

sentences.en: They show up as multicolored dots of light.
sentences.zh: 它们显示为多色发光点。

sentences.en: So that's the graphic of all the traffic signals.
sentences.zh: 所以那是所有交通信号灯的图表。

sentences.en: Every dot is a node or a traffic signal and that's our signal network.
sentences.zh: 每个点都是一个节点或交通信号灯，这就是我们的信号网络。

sentences.en: This shows in real time the status of the signals in the city.
sentences.zh: 这实时显示了城市中信号灯的状态。

sentences.en: Every color represents something to us.
sentences.zh: 每种颜色对我们来说都代表着某种意义。

sentences.en: And although it just looks like a Christmas tree to some people, it tells us the operation of the signals just at quick glance.
sentences.zh: 虽然在某些人看来它只是一棵圣诞树，但只需一眼它就能告诉我们信号灯的运行状况。

sentences.en: We're looking at, you know, the layout of Los Angeles, mostly green.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是，你知道的，洛杉矶的布局，大部分是绿色的。

sentences.en: Could you explain to me, like, what patterns you see?
sentences.zh: 你能向我解释一下，比如你看到了什么模式吗？

sentences.en: When you look at this, what does this actually mean to you?
sentences.zh: 当你看到这个时，这实际上对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: Okay, so green means it's online, good communication.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以绿色意味着它在线，通讯良好。

sentences.en: It's running a cycle length.
sentences.zh: 它正在运行一个周期长度。

sentences.en: Right now, we're coming up on just past the AM peak traffic period.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们刚刚过了早高峰交通期。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So things are starting to slow down.
sentences.zh: 所以情况开始慢下来了。

sentences.en: As Eric explained, most of the traffic lights were working well and they were running their usual timing.
sentences.zh: 正如埃里克所解释的那样，大部分交通信号灯工作正常，并且按照常规时间运行。

sentences.en: As the cars start to congest, it ramps up the green time to help provide throughput to get people through that area.
sentences.zh: 随着汽车开始拥堵，它会增加绿灯时间，以提供通行能力，帮助人们穿过该地区。

sentences.en: So these are the smarteSt.
sentences.zh: 所以这些是最聪明的。

sentences.en: The ones with the pink in the middle are the smartest intersections that we operate.
sentences.zh: 中间带粉色的那些是我们运营的最聪明的交叉路口。

sentences.en: Could I ask you about one intersection in particular that really grinds my gears?
sentences.zh: 我能问你一个让我特别抓狂的交叉路口吗？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Are you from L.A.?
sentences.zh: 你是洛杉矶人吗？

sentences.en: I am from L.A.
sentences.zh: 我是洛杉矶人。

sentences.en: Awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: It's pretty close to me.
sentences.zh: 它离我很近。

sentences.en: Do you know what the Fairfax asterisk is?
sentences.zh: 你知道什么是费尔法克斯星号路口吗？

sentences.en: That's Olympic Fairfax San Vicente?
sentences.zh: 那是奥林匹克、费尔法克斯和圣维森特路口吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So that was designed well before we had our current eyeballs.
sentences.zh: 所以那是远在我们有现在的监控眼光之前设计出来的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's so bad and there's nothing I can do about that.
sentences.zh: 它太糟糕了，对此我无能为力。

sentences.en: We've viewed that through the lens of 50, 60 years of traffic.
sentences.zh: 我们通过50、60年交通的镜头来看待这个问题。

sentences.en: We have put that into traffic signal modeling software.
sentences.zh: 我们已经把它放进了交通信号建模软件中。

sentences.en: We've done everything we can.
sentences.zh: 我们已经尽力了。

sentences.en: And I hate to say this, but the confluence of three major streets during peak hours leads to nothing but frustration and signal timing can't fix it.
sentences.zh: 我很不想这么说，但在高峰期三条主要街道的汇流只会带来沮丧，信号灯定时无法解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And we had just inherited that very bizarre, geometrically bizarre intersection that has terrific signals.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚接手了这个非常奇特、几何形状奇特的交叉路口，那里有极好的信号灯。

sentences.en: And we have to assign right away two different streets going east-west and one going north-south.
sentences.zh: 我们必须为东西走向的两条不同街道和南北走向的一条街道分配通行权。

sentences.en: And it's proven to be a very difficult thing.
sentences.zh: 事实证明这是一件非常困难的事情。

sentences.en: I don't know that it'll get better.
sentences.zh: 我不知道它会不会变好。

sentences.en: Do you feel like you have to kind of just do what you can with, like, the mess that you've been given?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得你只能勉强应付给你留下的这个烂摊子？

sentences.en: I mean, that's exactly how I feel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这正是我此刻的感受。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm only laughing because you describe what goes on in my mind every day.
sentences.zh: 我笑只是因为你描述的正是每天在我脑海中发生的事情。

sentences.en: It's that space-time problem again, as Salita Reynolds described it.
sentences.zh: 正如萨利塔·雷诺兹（Salita Reynolds）所描述的那样，这又是那个时空问题。

sentences.en: The ATTAC system has improved traffic in L.A., but it can't control the fundamental layout of the streets or the number of people using them.
sentences.zh: ATTAC系统改善了洛杉矶的交通，但它无法控制街道的基本布局或使用它们的人数。

sentences.en: It can't control the fact that L.A.
sentences.zh: 它无法改变洛杉矶作为一个世界上最以汽车为中心的城市之一被建造的事实。

sentences.en: was built as one of the most car-centric cities in the world.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶作为一个世界上最以汽车为中心的城市之一被建造的事实是无法控制的。

sentences.en: Engineers can play with time, coaxing millions of people through various bottlenecks.
sentences.zh: 工程师们可以利用时间，诱导数百万人在各个瓶颈路段通行。

sentences.en: But sometimes, no matter how advanced their algorithms, it's still kind of lipstick on a pig.
sentences.zh: 但有时，无论他们的算法多么先进，它仍然有点像给猪涂口红。

sentences.en: And they're still left with something like the Fairfax asterisk, an intersection that just was not designed to handle so many cars.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然只能面对像费尔法克斯星号路口这样根本没有设计来应对如此多汽车的交叉路口。

sentences.en: So, I just want to understand sort of how much what we've learned about ATTAC might apply to another city.
sentences.zh: 所以，我只是想了解一下我们对ATTAC的了解能在多大程度上适用于另一个城市。

sentences.en: So, if someone's sitting at a red light in another city, you know, Des Moines, Miami, how much of what's happening is basically the same?
sentences.zh: 因此，如果有人在另一个城市的红灯前坐着，比如得梅因、迈阿密，发生的事情有多少基本上是一样的？

sentences.en: And how much is really unique to the ATTAC system itself?
sentences.zh: 又有多少是ATTAC系统本身真正独有的？

sentences.en: A lot of other cities will have maybe part of the city on a connected traffic management system.
sentences.zh: 许多其他城市可能拥有连接交通管理系统的一部分城市。

sentences.en: And most other major metropolitan areas will have a centralized traffic management center where they'll be the same kind of setup.
sentences.zh: 而且大多数其他主要大都市区也会有一个集中式的交通管理中心，那里也会有类似的设置。

sentences.en: There'll be some cameras, there'll be some video, but it's usually for some subset of their city, some smaller, you know,
sentences.zh: 会有一些摄像头，会有一些视频，但通常只针对他们城市的一部分，比如较小的一块，你知道的，

sentences.en: maybe it's the downtown and it's a sort of a smaller scale kind of place where things are being managed.
sentences.zh: 也许是市中心，这是一个规模相对较小的、进行交通管理的地方。

sentences.en: And so, it is a repeatable sort of blueprint that has become kind of state of the practice.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个可复制的蓝图，已经成为一种行业惯例。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And then, finally, another Olympics are coming.
sentences.zh: 然后，最后，另一届奥运会即将到来。

sentences.en: It's 44 years after ATTAC was born.
sentences.zh: 距离ATTAC诞生已经过去了44年。

sentences.en: Is it going to play a similar role this time around?
sentences.zh: 这一次它会扮演类似的角色吗？

sentences.en: Is it going to expand again?
sentences.zh: 它会再次扩展吗？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: It's going to play a similar role.
sentences.zh: 它将发挥类似的作用。

sentences.en: And we have some more tricks up our sleeve in terms of what does ATTAC 3.0 look like for the 28 games and how can we make sure that we're moving the trains and the buses and keeping people on foot safe and getting around by bike or scooter,
sentences.zh: 我们在28年奥运会上推出的ATTAC 3.0还有更多杀手锏，比如如何确保我们的列车和公交车平稳运行，保证步行者的安全，以及通过骑自行车或滑板车出行，

sentences.en: one of the most fun and attractive ways to do so.
sentences.zh: 这是最有趣、最具吸引力的出行方式之一。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much, Salida.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你，萨利达。

sentences.en: It was really fun to learn about this system.
sentences.zh: 了解这个系统真的很有趣。

sentences.en: We really appreciate having you on.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你能来。

sentences.en: Yeah, my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 好的，我的荣幸。

sentences.en: We're about to go through the intersection.
sentences.zh: 我们马上要穿过这个路口了。

sentences.en: Back at that terrible intersection, Vivian and Cody are waiting.
sentences.zh: 回到那个可怕的路口，薇薇安和科迪正在等待。

sentences.en: We're just sitting at a red light, so this might be a lot of dead air for a while.
sentences.zh: 我们正坐在红灯前，所以接下来可能会有一段很长的空白时间。

sentences.en: It's crossing the intersection on rollerblades.
sentences.zh: 踩着轮滑鞋穿过路口。

sentences.en: Isn't that crazy?
sentences.zh: 这不是很疯狂吗？

sentences.en: In the dark, too.
sentences.zh: 而且还是在黑暗中。

sentences.en: In the dark.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗中。

sentences.en: But pretty soon, the light changes and they start to move.
sentences.zh: 但很快，灯变绿了，他们开始移动。

sentences.en: Okay, we are turning left on Fairfax.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们正在左转进入费尔法克斯。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们走吧。

sentences.en: Oh, green lights.
sentences.zh: 哦，绿灯。

sentences.en: All the way.
sentences.zh: 一路绿灯。

sentences.en: All right, that's it.
sentences.zh: 好了，就这样。

sentences.en: Not so bad, right?
sentences.zh: 没那么糟，对吧？

sentences.en: That wasn't so bad.
sentences.zh: 情况没有那么糟糕。

sentences.en: Not the worst traffic we've ever been in.
sentences.zh: 这还算不上我们遇到过最糟糕的交通状况。

sentences.en: We started with the question, how do LA's traffic lights actually work?
sentences.zh: 我们从这个问题开始：洛杉矶的交通信号灯到底是如何运作的？

sentences.en: And the answer is that the whole city is wired up.
sentences.zh: 答案是，整个城市都接入了网络。

sentences.en: There are sensors embedded in the pavement at many traffic lights, and they connect through
sentences.zh: 许多红绿灯的路面下都埋有传感器，它们通过

sentences.en: miles of underground fiber optic cables to a centralized control room.
sentences.zh: 数英里长的地下光缆连接到一个集中控制室。

sentences.en: In that control room, engineers monitor traffic flow and make adjustments in real time.
sentences.zh: 在那个控制室里，工程师们监控交通流量并实时进行调整。

sentences.en: It's a system that started very small when Ed Rowe and his team faced this impossible task, which was to keep traffic moving smoothly during the 1984 Olympic Games.
sentences.zh: 这个系统起步时规模很小，当时埃德·罗（Ed Rowe）和他的团队面临着一项不可能的任务，那就是在1984年奥运会期间保持交通顺畅。

sentences.en: And since then, the system has grown, and ATSAC now manages nearly 5,000 traffic lights at intersections across the city.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该系统不断发展，ATSAC现在管理着全市各个路口的近5000个交通信号灯。

sentences.en: With that, consider this service request resolved.
sentences.zh: 有了这个，这单服务请求就算完成了。

sentences.en: Today on the show, you heard Salita Reynolds, the chief innovation officer at LA Metro, and Eric Zambon,
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中，你听到了洛杉矶大都会交通局首席创新官萨利塔·雷诺兹（Salita Reynolds）以及埃里克·赞博恩（Eric Zambon）的讲话，

sentences.en: a transportation engineer in charge of the ATSAC Traffic Management Center for LADOT.
sentences.zh: 他是洛杉矶交通局ATSAC交通管理中心的负责人兼交通工程师。

sentences.en: You also heard Vivian Leigh, supervising producer at 99PI, and her husband, Cody Franklin.
sentences.zh: 你还听到了99PI的监管制片人薇薇安·李（Vivian Leigh）和她的丈夫科迪·富兰克林（Cody Franklin）的声音。

sentences.en: We're going to go to our pub now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在要去酒吧了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: What infrastructure mystery keeps you up at night?
sentences.zh: 有什么基础设施之谜让你夜不能寐？

sentences.en: Is there something in your life that you use every day, but you don't actually understand how it works?
sentences.zh: 你生活中是否有什么东西每天都在用，但你其实并不理解它是如何运作的？

sentences.en: Submit your service request by recording a voice memo with your question and emailing it to servicerequest at 99PI.org.
sentences.zh: 请通过录制包含你问题的语音备忘录并将其发送至 servicerequest@99PI.org 来提交你的服务请求。

sentences.en: And remember, the next time you're stuck in traffic and you are cursing the lights,
sentences.zh: 请记住，下次你堵在路上并咒骂红绿灯时，

sentences.en: know that somewhere there's an engineer who has spent years trying to steal back seconds on your behalf, one green light at a time.
sentences.zh: 你要知道，在某个地方，有一位工程师花费了数年时间，正试图为你争取哪怕几秒钟的时间，一次一个绿灯。

sentences.en: I'm Delaney Hall.
sentences.zh: 我是德兰妮·霍尔。

sentences.en: Infrastructure is everywhere, and we are here to help you decode it.
sentences.zh: 基础设施无处不在，而我们在这里帮助你解读它们。

sentences.zh: 《服务请求》是 99% Invisible 与 Campside Media 联合制作的节目。

sentences.zh: 本节目由朱莉娅·凯斯-莱文制作并进行事实核查，肖希·什穆洛维茨剪辑。

sentences.zh: 混音由伊万·莱·特雷姆文负责。

sentences.zh: 主题曲和音乐由斯旺·雷亚尔创作。

sentences.zh: 节目插图由埃琳·内斯特设计。

sentences.zh: 凯茜也是 99PI 的执行制片人。

sentences.zh: 马特·谢尔是 Campside 的执行制片人。
